item.gachawaifus.gacha_terminal.desc: Right-click: 1 pull (1 Pink Ball). Shift + right-click: x10. Pity: 1.6% base, rises from pull 51 and guaranteed at 64 (average ~37 pulls). A 5-star never comes up empty and there is a 15% DOUBLE pull (the next waifu in the rotation drops too). The featured waifu rotates each Minecraft day; check it with /banner.
item.gachawaifus.pink_ball.desc: One Gacha pull. Crafted with a diamond in the centre and copper, lapis lazuli, iron and coal in a cross. You also get one free every day (on login, or with /tirada). Spend it at the Gacha Terminal. /banner shows the featured waifu and your pity.
item.gachawaifus.blue_ball.desc: A pull saved for later. Nothing spends it yet.
item.gachawaifus.waifu_capsule.desc: Right-click: opens your collection. Shift + right-click your waifu: stores her. Click an entry: summons her. If a waifu falls in battle her soul stays in the capsule, and you revive her there with 4 diamonds.
